analysis.detail: nextcloud-hpb/nix:ffmpeg. ffmpeg 8.1.2 is linked only by janus-pp-rec and mjr2pcap (offline recording post-processors); the running janus does not map it, recordplay is disabled and no unit or timer runs those tools. Decided by migration 2026-11-12; review by 2027-05-11.

nextcloud-hpb/nix:ffmpeg. RTSP client redirect loop. ffmpeg is linked only by janus-pp-rec and mjr2pcap (offline recording post-processors); the running janus maps no libav* (checked in /proc on hrossen 2026-11-07, on the 8.1.2 build: the pin move rebuilds the same linkage), it loads only the videoroom, websockets and jsonlog plugins (recordplay is disabled in nextcloud-hpb.nix), and no unit or timer runs those tools. Decided by migration 2026-11-12; review by 2027-05-11.
